name: Cleopatra Selene II
contribution: A Ptolemaic princess, nominal Queen of Cyrenaica and Queen of Mauretania as co-ruler alongside her husband Juba II. She was an important royal woman in the early Augustan age.

checks.lead: Cleopatra Selene II, also known as Cleopatra VIII (Greek: Κλεοπάτρα Σελήνη; summer 40 BC – c. 5 BC; the numeration is modern), was a Ptolemaic princess, nominal Queen of Cyrenaica (34 BC – 30 BC) and Queen of Mauretania (25 BC – 5 BC) as co-ruler alongside her husband Juba II. She was an important royal woman in the early Augustan age.
